recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Islamic State of Afghanistan. Theocratic; the united states does not recognize the taliban government.
rulers: Taliban Leader HAYBATULLAH Akhundzada (since 15 August 2021); overall Taliban Leader HAYBATULLAH Akhundzada is the [so-called] Amir-ul Momineen of the Taliban and is effectively the head of government
government: theocratic; the United States does not recognize the Taliban Government
economy: low-income South Asian economy; economy stable after major contraction due to Taliban takeover, but recovery remains fragile; widespread poverty and obstacles to human development; import-reliant for food, fuel, and machinery; ongoing sanctions, suspended development aid, and frozen reserve assets GDP (PPP): $82.238 billion (2023 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: the Taliban claims authority over a Ministry of Defense and a National Army (aka Army of the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan, Islamic Emirate Army, or Afghan Army); it has also formed police forces under a Ministry of Interior (2025) Expenditure: 3.3% of GDP (2019)
origin: 19 August 1919 (from UK control over Afghan foreign affairs)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
